21 Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God; 22 Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts. (2 Corinthians 1:21-22 KJV)

This verse is giving us assurance that if you are born again, you are established, or fixed, in Christ. It is meant to give us confidence that our salvation is fixed and sure, unless you blasphemy the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32), or fail to obey Jesus (Hebrews 5:9).

The sealing in these verses, is very important, as it assures us of the security of our salvation, unless you blasphemy the Holy Ghost, or become reprobate (Romans 1:28), or disobey Jesus, and is the protection of our new born again spirits against any defilement from sin in our lives (Ephesians 1:13). The Holy Spirit is the down payment of our inheritance in Christ Jesus, assuring us that we will be fully redeemed, unless you blasphemy the Holy Ghost, or reject, or disobey, Jesus. Praise God for all His wonderful gifts to us, His children.
